texto: Vocabulary for cultural transmission and community life: «วัฒนธรรม» (wát-thá-ná-tham, culture / cultural customs), «ชุมชน» (chum-chon, community / neighbourhood), «ประเพณี» (bprà-phee-nii, traditional custom / popular tradition) and «สืบทอด» (sʉ̀ʉp-thɔ̂ɔt, to pass on across generations / to preserve / to perpetuate). To contrast continuity and change in customs use «แม้ว่า...แต่...» (although... yet...): «แม้ว่าประเพณีจะเปลี่ยนไป แต่ชุมชนยังสืบทอดความหมายเดิม» (Although the tradition changes, the community keeps its original meaning). For learning opportunities: «เปิดโอกาสให้...» (to give the opportunity to...).

opciones.texto: Local traditions are passed down from generation to generation through cultural events in the community.
opciones.explicacion: Correct: this option translates and accurately interprets the sentence «ประเพณีท้องถิ่นได้รับการสืบทอดจากรุ่นสู่รุ่นผ่านกิจกรรมทางวัฒนธรรมในชุมชน» from the text.

opciones.texto: Schools and learning centres organise activities so that young people can study local history.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this is another complementary statement from the passage, not the meaning of the sentence in question.

opciones.texto: Protecting folk arts and crafts strengthens a shared sense of identity.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this option corresponds to another sentence in the reading passage.
